mapper.select: SELECT D.NR_ITEM_CTG_NM AS title, C.NR_ITEM_NM || ' : ' || B.REC_CNTE AS content FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRFAE B ON A.NREC_ID = B.NREC_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON B.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRICD D ON C.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID = D.NR_ITEM_CTG_ID WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.NREC_FORM_CD = '701' ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ

SELECT B.STF_NM AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD B ON A.FSR_STF_NO = B.STF_NO WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.NREC_FORM_CD = '701'
